title: I rebuilt my old Unity game with AI. Badminton is a contact sport now
author: loghanv_dev

comments.author: loghanv_dev
comments.body:
hey, my game is called Bloody Badminton. i made the original in unity years ago and rebuilt the whole thing with AI as one html file. the pixel art and music are all generated by code, theres no image or audio files at all. runs straight in your browser and its coming to [itch.io](http://itch.io) soon



real question tho, would you actually play this? and what would make you wanna try it

replies.author: BloodMossHunter
replies.body: you know .. ive lived in asia.. they freaking love badminton.. might sell well there

replies.author: loghanv_dev
replies.body: oh for real? didnt even think about that, might have to add translations at some point lol. where in asia did you live?

replies.body: vieetnam thialand philippines bali , hk . i was there for 6 years. badminton is huge w chinese
